question: 从云南路地铁站步行到鼓楼地铁站，最短步行距离是多少米？
answer: 从云南路地铁站步行到鼓楼地铁站，最短步行距离为 905 米（约 11.31 分钟，按 □ km/h 计；直线距离 833 米）。

steps.sql: WITH a_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name = '云南路' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM a_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), b_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name = '鼓楼' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), b AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM b_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), r AS (SELECT * FROM pgr_dijkstra('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM a), (SELECT vid FROM b), false)) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(max(agg_cost), 0) FROM r) AS walk_m, (SELECT coalesce(max(agg_cost), 0) FROM r) / 80.0 AS walk_min, ST_Distance(a.pt::geography, b.pt::geography) AS straight_m, a.snap_m AS snap_a_m, b.snap_m AS snap_b_m, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_LineMerge((SELECT ST_Collect(e.geom ORDER BY r.seq) FROM r JOIN walk_edges e ON e.id = r.edge)), 6) AS geojson FROM a, b

args.answer: 从云南路地铁站步行到鼓楼地铁站，最短步行距离为 {R1.rows[0].walk_m} 米（约 {R1.rows[0].walk_min} 分钟，按 4.8 km/h 计；直线距离 {R1.rows[0].straight_m} 米）。

final_sql: WITH a_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name = '云南路' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), a AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM a_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), b_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name = '鼓楼' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), b AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM b_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), r AS (SELECT * FROM pgr_dijkstra('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM a), (SELECT vid FROM b), false)) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(max(agg_cost), 0) FROM r) AS walk_m, (SELECT coalesce(max(agg_cost), 0) FROM r) / 80.0 AS walk_min, ST_Distance(a.pt::geography, b.pt::geography) AS straight_m, a.snap_m AS snap_a_m, b.snap_m AS snap_b_m, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_LineMerge((SELECT ST_Collect(e.geom ORDER BY r.seq) FROM r JOIN walk_edges e ON e.id = r.edge)), 6) AS geojson FROM a, b

question: 奥体中心地铁站步行 15 分钟（4.8 km/h，可达道路两侧 50 米缓冲）可达范围有多少平方公里？
answer: 奥体中心地铁站步行 15 分钟（4.8 km/h，网络距离上限 1,200 米，可达道路两侧 50 米缓冲）的可达范围面积约为 1.48 平方公里（可达网络节点 188 个）。

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'metro_stations' AS layer, t.name, "station_type"::text AS category, (SELECT d.name FROM districts d WHERE ST_Within(t.geom, d.geom) LIMIT 1) AS district, 'name' AS matched_by, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t.name) AS same_name_count FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name LIKE '%奥体中心%') u ORDER BY length(name), name LIMIT 25

WITH o_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name = '奥体中心' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), o AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM o_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), reach AS (SELECT node, agg_cost FROM pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM o), 1200.0, false)), edges_in AS (SELECT e.geom FROM walk_edges e JOIN reach r1 ON r1.node = e.source JOIN reach r2 ON r2.node = e.target), poly AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_Union(ST_Buffer(ST_Simplify(ST_Transform(geom, 32650), 2), 50, 'quad_segs=2')), 4326) AS g FROM edges_in) SELECT 15.0::float AS minutes, 1200.0::float AS network_m, (SELECT count(*) FROM reach) AS reachable_nodes, ST_Area(poly.g::geography) / 1e6 AS area_km2, o.snap_m AS snap_m, ST_AsGeoJSON(poly.g, 6) AS geojson FROM poly, o

args.answer: 奥体中心地铁站步行 15 分钟（4.8 km/h，网络距离上限 {R2.rows[0].network_m} 米，可达道路两侧 50 米缓冲）的可达范围面积约为 {R2.rows[0].area_km2} 平方公里（可达网络节点 {R2.rows[0].reachable_nodes} 个）。

final_sql: WITH o_p AS (SELECT t.geom AS pt FROM "metro_stations" t WHERE t.name = '奥体中心' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1), o AS (SELECT p.pt, v.id AS vid, ST_Distance(p.pt::geography, v.geom::geography) AS snap_m FROM o_p p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, geom FROM walk_vertices WHERE in_main ORDER BY geom <-> p.pt LIMIT 1) v), reach AS (SELECT node, agg_cost FROM pgr_drivingDistance('SELECT id, source, target, cost_m AS cost, cost_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_edges', (SELECT vid FROM o), 1200.0, false)), edges_in AS (SELECT e.geom FROM walk_edges e JOIN reach r1 ON r1.node = e.source JOIN reach r2 ON r2.node = e.target), poly AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_Union(ST_Buffer(ST_Simplify(ST_Transform(geom, 32650), 2), 50, 'quad_segs=2')), 4326) AS g FROM edges_in) SELECT 15.0::float AS minutes, 1200.0::float AS network_m, (SELECT count(*) FROM reach) AS reachable_nodes, ST_Area(poly.g::geography) / 1e6 AS area_km2, o.snap_m AS snap_m, ST_AsGeoJSON(poly.g, 6) AS geojson FROM poly, o

question: 按 GB 50180-2018 对初中服务半径的要求，诚品城小区沿步行路网是否有中学？
